threads.body: [Testing] This wiring is what enables AWS SDK spans to emit exceptions as log records under `otel.semconv.exception.signal.preview=logs`, but there doesn’t appear to be an integration test in the AWS SDK test suites that exercises this mode and asserts the emitted log record event name/severity. Without such a test, it’s easy to regress by removing/misplacing this customizer call (or missing a specific instrumenter). Consider adding a test that forces `otel.semconv.exception.signal.preview=logs` and triggers a failed request, then asserts a single exception log record with the expected `rpc.client.call.exception` event name.
